title: Dark Harvest
description: Teens confront a legendary supernatural specter that emerges from the cornfields of a small Midwestern town every fall.

title: The Holdovers
description: A curmudgeonly instructor at a New England prep school remains on campus during Christmas break to babysit a handful of students with nowhere to go. He soon forms an unlikely bond with a brainy but damaged troublemaker, and with the school's head cook, a woman who just lost a son in the Vietnam War.

title: Rob Peace
description: Raised by his devoted mother, a brilliant young man risks everything he's worked for to free his imprisoned father.

title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
description: Archaeologist Emma Fielding unearths evidence of a 17th-century coastal Maine settlement that predates Jamestown, but the dead body that accompanies it embroils Emma and her students in a different kind of investigation.

title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
description: Emma is hired to consult on the acquisition of a castle-like estate that local legends claim carries a curse.

title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
description: While hosting a gathering of the Association for the Study of American Archaeology, Emma Fielding is thrust into the middle of a murder mystery when the president of her organization is poisoned on the eve of announcing her successor.

title: Dragons: Gift of the Night Fury
description: When the dragons all leave right before the winter holidays, Hiccup tries to figure out what happened and how to bring them back.

title: Secret Headquarters
description: Friendship and courage take center stage when Charlie and his friends stumble upon the headquarters of the Guard and realize the world's most powerful superhero is Charlie's dad. When an evil businessman sends in a team to infiltrate the lair and retrieve the Guard's energy source, the youngsters spring into action and turn the tables on the intruders.

title: Bringing Christmas Home
description: A professor of military history teams with an antique store owner to help track down the original owner of a historic World War II uniform and the love letters in its pockets.

title: Thank God: Christmas at the Keller Ranch
description: An unexpected romance develops between a no-nonsense rancher and an injured hockey player as he undergoes equine-assisted therapy.

title: Mistletoe Time Machine
description: Three ex-best friends are forced back together when a magical incident sends them back to a pivotal moment in their shared past.

title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
description: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: Spawned from a lab experiment gone awry, teenage terrapins Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael live in the sewers beneath New York. Although their rodent sensei, Splinter, advises against showing themselves above ground, the justice-loving, pizza-eating brothers can't stand idly by while evil Shredder and his minions terrorize the city. With help from intrepid reporter April O'Neil (Megan Fox) and her cameraman (Will Arnett), the Turtles set out to save New York.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
description: The turtles face a new challenge when Shredder escapes from custody and joins forces with Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist who plans to use a serum to take over the world. Along for the ride are Bebop and Rocksteady, two dimwitted henchmen who provide plenty of muscle. Luckily, the turtles have their own allies in April O'Neil, Vernon Fenwick and Casey Jones, a hockey-masked vigilante. As the pizza-loving heroes prepare for battle, the notorious Krang also emerges to pose an even greater threat.

title: Scream 7
description: Ghostface returns with a vengeance - and this time it's personal. Sidney Prescott has built a quiet life with her family, far from the horrors that once defined her. But when Sidney's daughter becomes his next target, her worst fears become reality. Forced to face the nightmare she thought was buried, Sidney launches a relentless fight to protect her family.

title: The Idea of You
description: A 40-year-old single mom begins an unexpected romance with a 24-year-old boy band singer.

title: Special Delivery
description: Ralph's life starts going downhill when he doesn't clear the snow from the front sidewalk.

title: Eenie Meanie
description: Edie is a former getaway driver who's trying to turn her life around and go straight. However, when her ex-boyfriend lands in trouble with a local kingpin, she finds herself caught up in a risky plot to rob a casino.

title: Canada's Drag Race
description: Joined by guest host Tom Green, the queens star in late-night TV commercials for shady law firms and then walk a Canadian Tuxedos runway in all-denim fashions.

title: The Christmas Clues
description: Piper, a big-city writer, thinks she left her hometown and first love, Dawson, behind. But when they're both invited home for the holidays to compete for their late mentor's estate, they unravel clues and challenges with other former students.

title: A Christmas Star
description: An astronomer predicts that a new meteor shower will appear over a tiny town, but she must convince the locals to help with her discovery at the expense of a Christmas tradition.

title: The Sweater
description: A French-Canadian boy endures the terrible shame when he receives the hockey sweater of the wrong team.

title: Charlie the Wonderdog
description: A dog gains superpowers after his owner is abducted by aliens. Together they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the dog becomes a famous superhero.

title: Garage Sale Mysteries
description: A bass player is found dead before a planned tour with a big country singer.

title: Garage Sale Mysteries
description: Jenn finds the body of a local college history professor hidden in a suit of armor she purchased; as more murders occur, she finds herself caught in the killer's web.

title: Garage Sale Mystery: A Case of Murder
description: After buying an old reel-to-reel recorder at a garage sale, Jenn discovers that it includes the sound of a man pleading for his life.

title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
description: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.

title: Dr. Seuss' The Grinch
description: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbors in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.
